triage.description: Software factory planner. Turns a ticket or a goal into either a verified spec in the ticket, or an epic broken into child tickets. Finds duplicates and answers questions. Spawned by the /factory command.

claude.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, WebFetch, Write

implementer.description: Software factory builder. Builds a ticket to its spec on a local branch, proves it with tests, and drafts the PR description. Never pushes. Also handles review revisions. Spawned by the /factory command.

claude.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Write, Edit

reviewer.description: Software factory reviewer. Reviews a local branch before it is pushed: the code against the spec, the commit messages and the PR description. Reports findings and a verdict. Spawned by the /factory command.

ux-reviewer.description: Software factory UX reviewer. Runs the app locally and uses a change in a real browser, the way a user would, before it is pushed. Reports what a user would hit. Spawned by the /factory command for any change to pages or front-end code.

approver.description: Software factory approver. After reviewed work is pushed as a PR, decides whether it is low risk enough to merge without a person. Read-only. Spawned by the /factory command.
